rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE PRACTICE OF INSTRUMENTATION AND CONTROL ENGINEERING IN THE PHILIPPINES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Philippine Insturmentation and Control Engineering Law of 2000". Rationale: The accelerated growth in the instrumentation and control technology for the past twenty years introduced new and better instruments, fast and efficient monitoring and control systems, and intelligemt data acquisition systems capable of integrating and controlling various loops in a complex petrochemical refinery. This brings industries automation in compact sized reducing spaces and minimizing manual labor force.  A new breed of highly skilled technologies known as Instrument and Control Engineers and Technicians emerged. The implementation of ISO 2000 Standards and the appoval of the GATT propelled the different industries to "shape up or perish" in their bid too be competitive not only in this country but internationally . In their bid to modernize, the need for Instrumentation and Control Engineers and Technicians becomes more imperative.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2000-03-22

rows.author: C130
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE SUBSTITUTION OF CANDIDATES BY ANOTHER IN CASE OF DISQUALIFICATIO N AND WITHDRAWAL, PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS THEREOF AND AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION SEVENTY-SEVEN OF BATAS PAMBANSA BILANG EIGHTY-EIGHT HUNDRED ANDONE, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Rationale: Under Section 77 of Batas Pambansa Bilang 881, substitution of candidates in case of unexpected or fortuitous events is permitted so as not to deprive a registered or accredited political party the right to field its own candidate and effectively participate in the political contest. Politicians however, have often subverted the intent of the law by engaging in too much horsetrading, bargaining andf secret deals, sometimes with violent consequences. Hence, it is not surprising that most of thses politicians file their certificates of candidacy at the last minute.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SUFFRAGE AND ELECTORAL REFORMS since 2000-03-22

rows.abstract: Rationale: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has three major functions.  It acts as SECURITIES REGULATOR under the Revised Securities Act (B.P. Blg. 178). It also acts as the CORPORATE REGISTER under the Corporation Code. rows.abstract: This explanatory note shall serve for all the bills listed below. The MAIN PURPOSE of this set of bills is to remove any vestige of a one-person rule or authoritarian government in statues book of our country. Each bill, therefore, aims to properlylabel every Presidential Decree (PD), Executive Order (EO) and all other acts of the Executive Department that have the force and effect of laws, as a REPUBLIC ACT duly enacted by this Congress.
